excludedRules.import/no-relative-parent-imports: Module-root relative imports are the documented public interface.
excludedRules.react/react-in-jsx-scope: The compiler uses the automatic react-jsx runtime.
excludedRules.import/no-named-export: Named module-root exports are the documented public interface.
excludedRules.import/prefer-default-export: Named module-root exports are the documented public interface.
excludedRules.import/no-default-export: Vite configuration requires a default export; named exports remain product convention.
excludedRules.import/no-nodejs-modules: Bun server and CLI use the Node platform API.
excludedRules.import/no-namespace: Namespace imports are necessary for typed platform APIs and test mocks.
excludedRules.import/extensions: Bun source execution and bundler resolution support both explicit and extensionless module roots.
excludedRules.import/unambiguous: TypeScript moduleDetection force establishes module identity, including declaration-only modules.
excludedRules.import/no-commonjs: Bun/Node diagnostic fixture subprocesses exercise CommonJS interfaces.
excludedRules.node/no-process-env: Environment is an explicit server/CLI and isolated test configuration input.
excludedRules.node/no-sync: ADR 0015 requires synchronous note read-modify-write with no async interleaving.
excludedRules.node/no-top-level-await: Bun ESM entrypoints and test setup require top-level asynchronous initialization.
excludedRules.oxc/no-async-await: Async lifecycle and I/O are part of the supported Bun/TypeScript contract.
excludedRules.oxc/no-optional-chaining: Optional protocol fields and partial results use supported ES2023 semantics.
excludedRules.oxc/no-rest-spread-properties: Immutable document replacement and typed projections require object copy semantics.
excludedRules.oxc/no-barrel-file: Named module-root public entrypoints are mandated by repository boundaries.
excludedRules.react/no-set-state: Interactive React state is part of the application contract.
excludedRules.react/jsx-no-literals: This internal single-language app has no localization message catalogue.
excludedRules.react/only-export-components: Module-root contracts may expose components alongside types and projections; HMR export shape is not a production constraint.
excludedRules.react/no-multi-comp: Related compound component parts belong to one module.
excludedRules.react/jsx-props-no-spreading: Official compound components and typed DOM prop forwarding require spreading.
excludedRules.no-ternary: Mutually exclusive with unicorn/prefer-ternary; retain the latter.
excludedRules.no-undefined: Optional wire/API values intentionally use undefined.
excludedRules.unicorn/no-null: JSON protocol and explicit nullable contracts intentionally use null.
excludedRules.no-void: Explicitly discarded callback values and handled async operations use void semantics; typed promise safety remains enabled.
excludedRules.one-var: Separate lexical bindings are clearer; formatter and prefer-const own declaration presentation.
excludedRules.init-declarations: Definitely assigned callback/lease variables may be initialized by a lifecycle boundary.
excludedRules.func-style: Named declarations and typed callback expressions serve different documented interfaces.
excludedRules.id-length: Domain coordinates x/y and conventional type parameters are meaningful short identifiers.
excludedRules.no-magic-numbers: Timing has its own canonical owner; a universal numeric ban incorrectly treats scene geometry and exact protocol fixtures as unnamed configuration.
excludedRules.max-statements: Physical file length and complexity bound structure without an additional arbitrary statement budget.
excludedRules.max-lines-per-function: Physical file length and complexity bound structure without splitting coherent contract cases by arbitrary function length.
excludedRules.max-params: Typed vendor callbacks have externally fixed arity.
excludedRules.no-bitwise: Binary/audio and pixel protocols require bitwise operations.
excludedRules.no-plusplus: Increment/decrement is supported iteration semantics; it introduces no separate product state.
excludedRules.no-continue: Early loop continuation preserves clear filter control flow and sequential I/O.
excludedRules.no-negated-condition: Mutually exclusive branch ordering preferences do not justify rearranging readable guards.
excludedRules.unicorn/no-negated-condition: Mutually exclusive branch ordering preferences do not justify rearranging readable guards.
excludedRules.no-nested-ternary: The Unicorn counterpart permits a clearer scoped policy; it remains enabled.
excludedRules.sort-keys: Protocol and fixture key order is intentional; alphabetical reordering is not a semantic contract.
excludedRules.sort-vars: Separate binding order can express data dependencies.
excludedRules.capitalized-comments: Code examples, identifiers and suppression directives are not prose sentences.
excludedRules.require-await: Use the type-aware TypeScript counterpart, which understands Promise-returning adapters.
excludedRules.no-throw-literal: Use typescript/only-throw-error for type-aware thrown-value safety.
excludedRules.prefer-promise-reject-errors: Use the TypeScript counterpart for type-aware rejection safety.
excludedRules.no-duplicate-imports: Use import/no-duplicates, which understands separate type imports.
excludedRules.no-redeclare: The TypeScript counterpart understands declaration merging.
excludedRules.unicorn/filename-case: Public React component names and vendored protocol type names use PascalCase; directory ownership is separately enforced.
excludedRules.unicorn/prefer-export-from: Explicit imported public bindings are needed for local use; module entrypoint rule owns re-export boundaries.
excludedRules.unicorn/no-array-reduce: Typed reductions are supported data projections; forbidding the API is not a product contract.
excludedRules.unicorn/no-process-exit: CLI and child-process fixtures need explicit exit status semantics.
excludedRules.unicorn/number-literal-case: Oxlint 1.80.0 requires uppercase hexadecimal digits while mandatory Oxfmt 0.65.0 deterministically restores lowercase (for example 0x428A2F98 to 0x428a2f98), and the rule exposes no configuration. Reconsider on either tool upgrade; Oxfmt owns literal case while numeric-separators-style remains enforced.
excludedRules.promise/avoid-new: Event-driven platform APIs require explicit Promise adapters.
excludedRules.promise/prefer-await-to-callbacks: Node event/listener callbacks are lifecycle API contracts.
excludedRules.promise/prefer-await-to-then: Promise chains are required in event adapters where no async caller owns the result; typed safety remains enabled.
excludedRules.promise/spec-only: Bun and ES2023 support additional Promise APIs beyond older rule vocabulary.
excludedRules.node/callback-return: Callback completion is not universally terminal for event listeners.
excludedRules.node/exports-style: Product source is ESM; CommonJS diagnostic fixture spelling is an external boundary.
excludedRules.node/no-mixed-requires: Product source is ESM; requires exist only in platform diagnostic fixtures.
excludedRules.jsdoc/require-param-type: TypeScript types are authoritative; duplicating signatures in JSDoc creates a second contract.
excludedRules.jsdoc/require-property-type: TypeScript types are authoritative; duplicating signatures in JSDoc creates a second contract.
excludedRules.jsdoc/require-returns-type: TypeScript types are authoritative; duplicating signatures in JSDoc creates a second contract.
excludedRules.jsdoc/require-throws-type: TypeScript types are authoritative; duplicating signatures in JSDoc creates a second contract.
excludedRules.jsdoc/require-yields-type: TypeScript types are authoritative; duplicating signatures in JSDoc creates a second contract.
